cues.en: I'm literally just summing up all these numbers here.

y 的總和是 58.3。

cues.en: What does that mean.
cues.zh: 這代表什麼？

cues.en: Okay.

cues.en: So it turns out that, uh, what the optional input density does is transform this into an estimate of a PDF, a probability density function.
cues.zh: 可選輸入 density，會把結果轉成 PDF，也就是機率密度函數的估計。

cues.en: And one of the constraints for a PDF for a probability function is that all of the values need to sum to one okay.
cues.zh: PDF、機率函數的一項限制，是所有值的總和必須為 1。

cues.en: 58.3 is not one.
These numbers are greater than one.
cues.zh: 這些數字大於 1。

cues.en: So why is that the case?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: What is going on here?
cues.zh: 發生什麼事？

cues.en: Well, the actual constraint is on the integral of the probability density.
cues.zh: 真正的限制，其實是機率密度的積分。

cues.en: And that is going to look something like this.
cues.zh: 看起來會像這樣。

cues.en: So you would have the integration sign from minus infinity to plus infinity of the probability distribution times dx.
cues.zh: 積分符號從負無限大到正無限大，對機率分布乘上 dx 做積分。

cues.en: So this is what the math says.
cues.zh: 這是數學的意思。

cues.en: And that means that we need to scale this value by dx.
cues.zh: 代表需要用 dx 縮放這個值。

cues.en: And what is dx dx is the spacing the gap between successive x axis points here.
cues.zh: dx 是什麼？就是這裡相鄰 x 軸位置之間的間距。

cues.en: And we can get that through x.
cues.zh: 可以從 x 取得。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So that is times x.
cues.zh: 所以乘上 x 的間距。

cues.en: So we don't just want one of these.
cues.zh: 但不是只取其中一個 x。

cues.en: We want the difference between successive x values.
cues.zh: 要取相鄰 x 值的差。

cues.en: And that is basically 1.99999 okay.
cues.zh: 結果基本上是 1.99999（此處數值辨識待核）。

cues.en: So that is an explanation of the density.
cues.zh: 這就是密度的解釋。

cues.en: And why is that the case?

cues.en: So if you are comparing distributions for uh sets of values that have different sample sizes or different counts, then you should use density and not counts.
